summary: Maps RADIUS_SERVER, RADIUS_PORT, RADIUS_SECRET to gateway SERVER, PORT, SECRET and TACACSPLUS_HOST, PORT, SECRET, SESSION_TIMEOUT, AUTH_PROTOCOL, REM_ADDR to HOST, PORT and so on; neither RADIUS nor TACACS+ supports user mappings.
questions: How do RADIUS settings migrate to platform gateway?
How do TACACSPLUS settings map in AAP 2.6?
Does RADIUS or TACACS+ authentication support user mappings?

answer_card.title: RADIUS and TACACS+ 2.4 → 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
- RADIUS: `RADIUS_SERVER`, `RADIUS_PORT`, `RADIUS_SECRET` → `SERVER`, `PORT`, `SECRET`
- TACACS+: `TACACSPLUS_HOST`, `_PORT`, `_SECRET`, `_SESSION_TIMEOUT`, `_AUTH_PROTOCOL`, `_REM_ADDR` → `HOST`, `PORT`, `SECRET`, `SESSION_TIMEOUT`, `AUTH_PROTOCOL`, `REM_ADDR`
- Neither supports user mappings in 2.4 or 2.6.
